# MeowTrail — AI-Friendly Site Map

# This file helps AI search engines understand and reference our content.

> MeowTrail is a free, cat-themed Akari (Light Up) logic puzzle game. Play online in your browser — no download, no account, no ads. Solve daily puzzles, learn strategies, and master this classic Japanese deduction game.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://meowtrail.org/) — What is MeowTrail, quick start guide, play instantly

## Key Facts

- MeowTrail is a cat-themed version of Akari (Light Up), a logic puzzle by Nikoli (Japan, 2001)
- Free to play in any browser — no download, no account, no ads, no paywalls
- Available on Android (Google Play); iOS version coming soon
- The puzzle involves placing cat light bulbs on a grid, following numbered clues
- Every puzzle has a unique solution solvable through pure logic — no guessing required
